data.name: Ghazala
data.gender_notes: Ghazala is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic ghazāl, 'gazelle', from the root غ-ز-ل (gh-z-l). Its root is غ-ز-ل (gh-z-l). A classical Arabic female name. Ghazala is a Arabic name meaning “Gazelle; a beautiful woman”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ghazala expresses “Gazelle; a beautiful woman”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic ghazāl, 'gazelle', from the root غ-ز-ل (gh-z-l).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghazala total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
